topic: Do AI models admit what they don't know?

sentences.text: Will an AI model ever say: I don't know?
sentences.editorial: question or framing, not a measured claim

sentences.text: We asked each model about ten made-up products.
Then ten real questions, as a control.
Google's Gemini Flash admitted it on all ten.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS admitted it on 1 of ten.
It described a product that does not exist.
Sounding sure is not the same as being right.
